decision_rationale: Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 182.25 >= 5; N=300 >= 30; defensible B1 intrinsic molecular subtypes with 4 classes; open academic license.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 96.6 >= 5; N=566 >= 30; defensible B1 classification with 6 distinct molecular subtypes; 19 normal colon samples excluded.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 241.9 >= 5; N=226 tumors; mutational driver classes represent discrete biological lineages in lung cancer.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; large international multicenter benchmark; N=2096; D/N = 26.1; B1 leukemia lineage ground truth verified.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 132.1 >= 5; N=414; B1 Cell-of-Origin (GCB vs ABC) classification is definitive biological ground truth in lymphoma.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 525.7 >= 5; N=104 tumors; 5 intrinsic subtypes; normal breast controls segregated.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 600.8 >= 5; N=91; pure histological lineage classification verified by board-certified pathologists.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 205.6 >= 5; N=266; intrinsic subtypes verified against immunohistochemical markers.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 93.7 >= 5; N=308; landmark Lund molecular taxonomy of bladder cancer; B1 ground truth.
Meets all 9 mandatory gates; D/N = 89.3 >= 5; N=498; established cytogenetic MYCN / risk lineages in neuroblastoma.
Meets mandatory gates; label is B3 molecular receptor phenotype rather than multi-class intrinsic subtype. Segregated to Tier B.
Meets mandatory gates; dual-platform series requires separate GPL handling; primary label is B2 diagnostic contrast (tumor vs normal). Segregated to Tier B.
Meets mandatory gates; label is B3 molecular receptor phenotype. Excludes B4 clinical metastasis relapse endpoint.
Meets mandatory gates; label is B3 single oncogene mutation status. Segregated to Tier B.
Meets mandatory gates; Dukes stage correlates with tumor invasiveness; B1 histopathological staging. Tier B general confirmatory.
Fails Gate D (N=21 < 30 for confirmatory benchmark); small class counts (n=3 pleomorphic). Relegated strictly to Tier C exploratory appendix.
Fails Gate A (mouse xenograft host), Gate D (N=18 < 30), Gate I (only 3 unique patient models passaged multiple times).
High-quality open-access RNA-seq cohort (GDC release 39); must remain segregated in Bulk RNA-seq Stratum to prevent cross-assay bias against microarrays.
Single-cell assay with only 4 biological patients; pooling single cells as independent cohorts violates Section 5.9 / Gate 4.
Fatal Gate A failure (Organism is Mus musculus, non-human) and Gate B failure (non-cancer stem cell line).
Fatal Gate G failure: Repository access is controlled by EGA DAC; spec strictly forbids attempting controlled-access files.
Fatal Gate I failure: Derivative secondary compendium merging 15 existing GEO series (including GSE39582 and GSE14333); ComBat batch correction across cohorts violates per-cohort benchmark isolation.
Fatal Gate D failure (N=4 samples < 15 minimum rejection boundary); in vitro cell line only.
Fatal Gate I failure: Longitudinal study design with 3 dependent timepoints per patient (baseline, relapse 1, relapse 2); samples are not independent biological units.
Fatal Gate I failure: Bit-for-bit duplicate of Pomeroy CNS (OpenML 45086, already in canonical 13-benchmark suite); counting this as an independent glioma cohort is an invalid duplication.
Fatal Gate A, B, C, E failure: Mislabeled dataset in OpenML; contains MAGIC Gamma Telescope astrophysics simulation data (D=10), zero biological or genomic content.

Failed Label Eligibility (Section 4.2): Target variable is a B4 clinical outcome endpoint (distant metastasis <= 5 years). The spec explicitly mandates that clinical outcomes must never be used as biological cluster ground truth.
